notDeployed: The work market is not available on this network yet.
emptyBounties: No bounties yet. Post the first one.

errorIssueRefRequired: An issue link or description is required.
errorRewardRequired: A reward greater than zero is required.
errorClaimWindowRequired: A claim window of at least one day is required.
